notes.title: Ghost Pub is Open!
notes.content:
Welcome GhostPub!






[img src="https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3337710/extras/01.gif?t=1751798588"]


GhostPub is a roguelike-based tycoon game. 
· Become the captain of a haunted pub and. 

Chart your course to success! 

· Let's find and make various cocktails!



[img src="https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3337710/extras/@Line.png?t=1751798588"]

Become the owner of a ghost tavern and achieve a successful start-up!

[img src="https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3337710/extras/02.png?t=1751798588"]

[img src="https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3337710/extras/03.png?t=1751798588"]

Let's find and make various cocktails!



Create and serve appropriate cocktails for ghosts who have visited ghost pubs. Ghosts order a variety of unique cocktails.

  

[img src="https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3337710/extras/04-1.png?t=1751798588"]

[img src="https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3337710/extras/04-2.gif?t=1751798588"]
